reviews.title: Voice and Video Calls Get Voice issue After the Latest Update
reviews.text:
After the latest update, we are facing a serious issue with both voice and video calls. Whenever we open any video or play any audio while using IMO, the call automatically gets voice neither coming nor going. After that, neither we can hear the other person nor can they hear us. This issue affects both voice and video calls and started only after the latest update. Please fix this bug as soon as possible, as it is making the app difficult to use.

I just opened another app while i was on a call 
Then after neither my voice not his voice is going or coming. Really this issue I m facing with just after new version I updated.
